marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The Executive’s guide to enterprise social media strategy : how social networks are radically transforming your business

"An actionable framework for developing and executing successful social media strategies supporting collaboration, teamwork and communication in modern corporations Using straightforward language, this book offers real-world stories and revealing anecdotes to demonstrate how executives and business leaders develop successful corporate social media strategies.
